content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-explained-digital|COREMERCH guide to creators]]-stack-started-generating|The Payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

The conventional payment processor options, Stripe and PayPal, offer a suite of tools to facilitate transactions, but they come with a price, including a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee and a 3.4% + $0.30 per international transaction fee for Stripe, and a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee for PayPal, and a 4.4% + $0.30 per international transaction fee for PayPal's cross-border transactions. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete, customizable, and scalable commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, without any additional fees, except for the 0.5% fee for on-chain crypto payment verification.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving many digital creators without access to their services, while PayPal has a more extensive network, but still excludes several countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, without any dependence on a specific payment processor or country-specific regulations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides complete ownership and control over the digital commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a cost-effective and scalable solution than Stripe and PayPal.

For Nigerian ebook sellers, Ghanaian template makers, and Pakistani digital creators, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a permanent structural alternative to the conventional payment processors, and provides complete ownership and control over the digital commerce infrastructure, and the ability to automate and deliver products to customers directly, without any intermediaries. You can deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) today and start selling your digital products online, without relying on Stripe or PayPal, and visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), follow these steps: deploy the complete, customizable, and scalable commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, without any additional fees, except for the 0.5% fee for on-chain crypto payment verification, configure the payment processor to process transactions in multiple cryptocurrencies, automate the sales process and deliver products to customers directly, without any intermediaries, test the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) thoroughly before handoff, and engage with our 30-day support team to ensure a smooth deployment and operation.

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides complete ownership and control over the digital commerce infrastructure, allowing digital creators to customize and automate their sales processes, and deliver their products to customers directly, without any intermediaries.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee, and provides complete ownership and control over the payment verification process, allowing digital creators to automate and deliver payments to customers directly, without any intermediaries.
Can I deliver my digital products to customers directly using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides complete ownership and control over the digital commerce infrastructure, allowing digital creators to automate and deliver their products to customers directly, without any intermediaries.
What if I need to scale my digital commerce infrastructure?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to be scalable and customizable, allowing digital creators to easily scale their infrastructure to meet growing demand, and provides complete ownership and control over the digital commerce infrastructure, allowing digital creators to automate and deliver their products to customers directly, without any intermediaries.
